hint.gather: Tap Gather: your crew brings in a burst of what the tools find.
hint.collect: Collect banks what your crew gathered. A full store stops them, so bank before it fills.
hint.build: You can afford the next base tier: more room, more furnaces.
hint.tools: Better tools are affordable: open Upgrade to gather faster.
hint.furnace: Ore is piling up: build or feed the furnace to turn it into ingots.
hint.craft: Storage is tight: craft a crate for more room.
hint.barrel: A barrel washed up: tap it on the shore before it drifts off.
hint.building: A builder is free and a building is affordable: open Upgrade to put it up.
hint.map: Your crew can head out: open the Map, scout the fog, send a party to the ruins.

build.hint: Each tier raises storage, furnace slots and builders. Upkeep rises with it.
build.tools_hint: Tools: {tool}. Better tools gather more, and new kinds of things.
build.tools_maxed: Your tools are the best there are.

craft.blueprint_needed: Blueprint needed: find it in barrels, perfect node runs or daily tasks.
craft.pinned_empty: Pin the recipes you make often: open one and tap Pin.

smelt.gather_first: Gather some first: the rocks around the base.

inventory.parts_hint: Made at the stations. No storage limit; tap one to make more.

squad.treat_none: Make bandages at the loom to treat injuries

tasks.hint: Three small goals a day. Rewards land the moment a task completes. New set in {time}.
tasks.haul_hint: Nodes pay in full until the day's haul is in, then a little. Resets with the tasks.

login.title: Wipe Day
login.pitch: A small holdfast on a wrecked island. Gather, build, craft, and come back to see it grow.
login.discord_unavailable: Discord login is not set up here
login.failed: Login did not go through. Try again.
login.dev_hint: Development: play as a test player.
login.offline: The game server did not answer. Check your connection and try again.

workbench.name: Workbench
workbench.blurb: Where tools and gear are made. Each level opens more recipes.

furnace.name: Furnace
furnace.blurb: Turns ore into ingots, sulfur ore into sulfur and fat into fuel.

campfire.name: Campfire
campfire.blurb: A fire to gather round; grows into a kitchen that keeps the crew going.

warehouse.name: Warehouse
warehouse.blurb: Shelves and sheds: more room for everything.

garden.name: Garden
garden.blurb: Plots of flax and greens that grow fibre on their own.

loom.name: Loom
loom.blurb: Spins fibre faster; cloth and rope come later.

bunkhouse.name: Bunkhouse
bunkhouse.blurb: Beds for the crew: they work the nodes longer each day.

lights.name: Lights
lights.blurb: Lamps around the yard, so work goes on after dark.

tannery.name: Tannery
tannery.blurb: Racks and vats: more hide from every hunt.

kiln.name: Charcoal Kiln
kiln.blurb: Charcoal burns hotter: the furnace needs less fuel.

press.name: Oil Press
press.blurb: Presses every scrap of fat out of what the crew brings in.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.blurb: A lookout that spots barrels early, so they wait longer.

walls.name: Walls
walls.blurb: A wall around the base: it holds together longer when upkeep runs short.

generator.name: Generator
generator.blurb: Power for the furnace blowers: faster smelting, burns a little fuel.

radio_mast.name: Radio Mast
radio_mast.blurb: Listens for wreck chatter: barrels wash up more often.

dock.name: Dock
dock.blurb: A jetty and a boat: fishing brings in fat every hour.

effect.haulMinutes: +{value} min of node haul a day
effect.graceHours: +{value} h before upkeep costs a level

mule.name: Mule
mule.effect: Carries one more haul home; +15% at a node

navigator.name: Navigator
navigator.effect: Trips 15% shorter; sure-footed in flooded places

marksman.name: Marksman
marksman.effect: Better odds where it turns hostile; a sharp guard

demolition.name: Demolition
demolition.effect: Better odds where the way is blocked

medic.name: Medic
medic.effect: Fewer injuries in the party; heals faster

cautious.name: Cautious
cautious.effect: Fewer injuries; careful where the ground is unstable

brave.name: Brave
brave.effect: Better odds everywhere; steady on guard

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.effect: Finds blueprints and map scraps more often

landing.name: The Landing
landing.blurb: Your stretch of shore. The wreck on the rocks is the first place worth a look.

tidal_flats.name: Tidal Flats
tidal_flats.blurb: Mud, reeds and an old campground half sunk in them.

pine_ridge.name: Pine Ridge
pine_ridge.blurb: Dark pines on the rise behind the holdfast; paths lead on north and east.

ferry_point.name: Ferry Point
ferry_point.blurb: Where the ferry used to dock: ticket halls and rows of rusted cars.

rust_bay.name: Rust Bay
rust_bay.blurb: A bay of red water below the old cannery.

quarry_hills.name: Quarry Hills
quarry_hills.blurb: Terraced stone and a flooded pit, machines still standing in it.

stormcap.name: Stormcap
stormcap.blurb: Bare cliffs where the wind never stops. Someone kept a weather station up here.

sulfur_springs.name: Sulfur Springs
sulfur_springs.blurb: Yellow pools and the smell of eggs. The mine shafts start here.

signal_hill.name: Signal Hill
signal_hill.blurb: The island's high point, crowned by a white dome.

rail_yards.name: Rail Yards
rail_yards.blurb: Frozen sidings and a depot full of locomotives nobody will drive again.

north_dam.name: North Dam
north_dam.blurb: A concrete wall across the valley, and the power station under it.

the_narrows.name: The Narrows
the_narrows.blurb: A strait of fast water off the west coast; something was built into the cliffs.

open_water.name: Open Water
open_water.blurb: Past the last rocks, a platform stands on stilts in the swell.

beach_wreck.name: Beach Wreck
beach_wreck.blurb: A fishing boat broken on the rocks, still full of rope and nets.

old_campground.name: Old Campground
old_campground.blurb: Tents, a shop shell and whatever the campers left behind.

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.blurb: Cut stone, loose ore, and workshops with gears in the drawers.

cannery.name: Cannery
cannery.blurb: Rusted lines and a cold store. Something else has moved in.

ferry_terminal.name: Ferry Terminal
ferry_terminal.blurb: Cars, halls, a lost-luggage room nobody emptied.

observatory.name: Observatory
observatory.blurb: Lenses, springs, clockwork and a library of plans.

weather_station.name: Weather Station
weather_station.blurb: Instruments, plates and fuel, in rooms the sea keeps reaching.

flooded_mine.name: Flooded Mine
flooded_mine.blurb: Sulfur veins and ore, deep in dark water.

rail_depot.name: Rail Depot
rail_depot.blurb: Locomotives, cranes and sheds of spare parts, behind a copper-keyed gate.

power_station.name: Power Station
power_station.blurb: Turbines in the dark, and a control room with a brass-keyed safe.

submarine_pen.name: Submarine Pen
submarine_pen.blurb: A bunker cut into the cliffs, its pens half full of sea.

offshore_platform.name: Offshore Platform
offshore_platform.blurb: The season's peak: everything is out here, and so is everyone else.

beach_wreck.success: {name} climbed through the wheelhouse and came back hauling rope and a sack of odds and ends.
beach_wreck.partial: {name} got aboard, but the tide came in fast; they grabbed what they could.
beach_wreck.fail: The hull shifted under {name}. Nothing came back but wet boots.

old_campground.success: {name} cleared the shop shell and found the campers' stores untouched.
old_campground.partial: {name} dug through the tents; most had been picked over already.
old_campground.fail: {name} found the paths choked with fallen trees and turned back.

quarry.success: {name} got the old winch going and hauled up a load of stone and ore.
quarry.partial: {name} worked the loose rock at the edge of the pit and filled a cart.
quarry.fail: A slide closed the ramp. {name} walked the long way home empty-handed.

cannery.success: {name} slipped past the squatters and cleared the cold store.
cannery.partial: {name} was spotted at the loading bay but got away with a few crates.
cannery.fail: {name} was chased off the lines before reaching anything worth taking.

ferry_terminal.success: {name} cracked the lost-luggage room: scrap, cloth, and more.
ferry_terminal.partial: {name} went through the cars in the lot; slim pickings, but something.
ferry_terminal.fail: Someone else had the terminal. {name} kept their head down and left.

observatory.success: {name} brought back clockwork from the dome and a roll of old plans.
observatory.partial: {name} reached the lower floor before the stairs gave out.
observatory.fail: The dome groaned in the wind and {name} decided it was not worth it.

weather_station.success: {name} got between the waves and cleared the instrument rooms.
weather_station.partial: {name} salvaged the outer sheds while the sea was out.
weather_station.fail: The spray never let up. {name} could not get near the door.

flooded_mine.success: {name} waded the first shaft and brought up sulfur and ore.
flooded_mine.partial: {name} worked the dry end of the tunnel and filled a few sacks.
flooded_mine.fail: The water was higher than the charts said. {name} turned back.

rail_depot.success: {name} swiped the copper key and walked the sheds end to end with a cart.
rail_depot.partial: {name} worked the yard outside the sheds before the guards came round.
rail_depot.fail: {name} found the depot occupied and kept to the frozen ditches all the way home.

power_station.success: {name} got the control room open and stripped the spare-parts store.
power_station.partial: {name} reached the turbine hall; the stairs down were gone.
power_station.fail: The dam groaned and {name} decided the dark could keep its secrets.

submarine_pen.success: {name} brought the boat in on the tide and cleared the dry pens.
submarine_pen.partial: {name} searched the upper gantries while the water rose.
submarine_pen.fail: The current pushed the boat off the cliffs. {name} never got inside.

offshore_platform.success: {name} climbed the stilts at dawn and emptied the platform's stores.
offshore_platform.partial: {name} got onto the lower deck and grabbed what was in reach.
offshore_platform.fail: The swell was too high to tie up. {name} circled once and came home.

map.overview_hint: Tap a region to scout it, a ruin to send a party.
map.fog_blurb: Nobody knows what is out there yet. Send someone to look.
map.no_sites: Nothing worth a trip here; the way on runs through it.
map.far: Too far for now: a {tier} base can supply a scout that far.
map.hidden: Scout the regions next to it first.
map.scouting_now: A scout is on the way there.
map.scout_line: A scout needs {time} there and back.
map.party_there: A party is there: back in {time}.
map.loot_line: A success brings {rolls} hauls, each one of: {loot}.

report.scouted: {name} walked {region} end to end and mapped what is there.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.line: Ambushed on the way: they dropped part of the haul to get away.

cache.name: Hidden cache
cache.line: A hidden cache under the floor: {rolls} more hauls.

stranger.name: A stranger
stranger.line: {name} found someone hiding in the ruins and brought them home.
